'''Tweeta''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She stayed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where she aided in the fight against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War|Ord Mantell Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tweeta was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war, she helped the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] and worked with them on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> While stationed on the planet she and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="Legitimate Business" />

During the civil war she stayed in [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the planet, where she worked with another Rodian named [[Wentell Pron]]. Pron was looking to make new connections in the smuggling world whilst on the planet and Tweeta would direct anyone she met who she suspected shared her trade to him.<ref name="Legitimate Business" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Tweeta at one point in the war directed a [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] who worked with [[Rendia Freight]] to Wentell. The smuggler paid the Rodian at least once to teach them a number of combat and smuggling techniques.<ref name="Legitimate Business" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
During her time at Garnik Tweeta wore a [[gray]] suit and matching pants with [[brown]] boots. She was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] which he kept attached to his belt at the hip when not in use.<ref name="Legitimate Business" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tweeta is a Non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. She directs characters of the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class to the games first smuggler class trainer and the only one on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It is impossible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with Tweeta as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.
